Lindemann was found at the brownstone. A glass is on its side and the spill had not yet reached the edge of the table when it dried. The ice was brought in at 11:00 PM and the iceman’s book has the delivery timed and signed for.
The coroner puts death between 10:00 PM and 11:30 PM — two hours of nothing useful. Chloral hydrate in the stomach. No wound, no bruising, no sign of a struggle.
A bottle of chloral drops is gone from the speakeasy. The bottle is gone from the shelf and the ring of dust it stood in is still there.

The name Hauck was born with turns up on a desertion warrant from 1918. Hauck has been hiding from the Army for eleven years and from nobody else.
The papers are forged and the reason is plain: Hauck was put out of the country once already and does not mean to be put out twice.
